description: A squat vending pillar planted at the plaza's edge, its smeared touch-panel cycling headlines behind scratched polycarbonate. Papers stand racked and chained inside; a worn button reads VEND. It hums, waiting to sell you the day.

flags.vend_line: The pillar clunks, whirs, and posts a fresh Coldwater Sentinel through the slot, still warm and already implicating your fingers.

name: newsstand pillar
